catalogue_role: Supplementary experimental/policy catalogue. The implemented generating grammar is the source-bound native_core, not this flat operation list.
title: Marici generating grammar
authority: Canonical maintenance record for this grammar audit, created at operator request; does not supersede cited source contracts or confer theorem/publication authority.
scope: Mathematical and retained-record operations in the explicitly listed source slices; not repository workflow commands or an exhaustive inventory of sector operations.

source_basis.description: The operator's S4 object includes object, transport and joint object/transport. Its exact typed source signature has not been frozen. Do not silently replace it with a bare group or bare four-point set.
source_basis.acceptance: Record the source sorts, structure maps, equations, permitted constructions and equivalence criterion, with authoritative source references. Then audit dependencies against that fixed signature.

sorts.TypeExpr: Type expression over a supplied base type Q; full constructor word retained.
sorts.Presentation: Container presentation with its expression word and reversible codecs.
sorts.Equivalence: An actual equivalence with inverse data, not equality of cardinalities.
sorts.RecordSet: Labelled records with declared source and target fields and retained members.
sorts.RecordView: An indexed presentation with enough metadata for exact reconstruction.
sorts.FamilySet: Declared groups of records, retaining every member or its recoverable link.
sorts.Comparison: Typed actual/reference maps and construction parents; higher witnesses when required.
sorts.FramePackage: Typed maps, witnesses and any metric in a declared frame.
sorts.History: Retained witness/parent data with declared observation and permission policy.
sorts.AdmissionProfile: Permissions for a specified request family, not arbitrary observables.
sorts.OperandPair: Two explicitly supplied operand occurrences with dependency identities.

seeds.rule: A supplied base type Q starts the experimental expression grammar.

unsupported_families.reason: All 33 defined functions/methods are now classified with source rules and exact finite tests in semantic-extensions.json. Their operational interpretation into native Resolve remains open; noninjective averaging cannot be replaced by a comparison equivalence.

All nine rows now have typed assessments in completions-and-policies.json. Family-retention and supplied-operand pairing have compiled native derivations with premise recovery. DG computations, reference updates and permission policies still lack full operational interpretations; assessment is not derivation.

operations.name: Product-product
operations.gap: This type-building constructor is not identified with an operation of the intended S4 object.

operations.name: Sum-product
operations.gap: No coverage theorem identifies this experimental constructor with family promotion.

operations.name: Product-sum
operations.gap: Independent operands here are part of the declared semantics, not consequences of a fresh label.

operations.name: Normalize a type expression
operations.rule: Construct codecs to Sigma(bits:Bool^a).Pi(position:Fin(2^b)).Q by recursion on the expression.
requires: Expression generated by the three type constructors
operations.gap: Closure applies to this experimental type language, not yet to all Marici operations.

operations.name: Compare container presentations
operations.rule: For equal container signatures, decode_target composed with encode_source gives the comparison.
operations.gap: A complete generating relation set between constructor words remains open.

operations.name: Re-present retained records
operations.rule: Index the same retained records by label, from-label or to-label; provide exact reconstruction.
operations.gap: Reindexing does not by itself create a successor transport.

operations.name: Group with retained members
operations.rule: Group by declared keys with retain_members=True.
operations.gap: The source must select grouping keys; aggregation alone is not this operation.

operations.name: Promote families
operations.rule: Give each retained family one fresh label in a declared namespace, with next-level endpoint fields.
operations.gap: Endpoint assignment and horizontal generator are not supplied by fresh labelling.

operations.name: Passive frame change
operations.rule: Transport maps, witnesses and any metric together by the supplied typed frame equivalence.
operations.gap: Relabelling covariance does not establish selection of an active operation.

operations.name: Compose reference-aware comparisons
operations.gap: Same cell degree; this is not a higher-cell or family-promotion constructor.

operations.name: Fixed-frame comparison with return
operations.rule: C_new=C2*r*C1 with recorded reference correction and higher witnesses.
operations.gap: Not silently identified with ordinary composable-pair comparison composition.

operations.name: Witnessed reference substitution
operations.rule: Keep actual maps fixed; version reference and witnesses using a selected retained anchor and its reference-change witness.
operations.gap: Physical reference or mask selection is not supplied by the fixed-domain construction.

operations.name: Protected active frame request
operations.rule: For an admitted g: C'=g*C, d'=g*d, r'=r*g^-1; keep u,v fixed and update W with its certificate.
operations.gap: Interpreting a permutation as an active intervention is a separate policy.

operations.name: Permitted history edit
operations.rule: Edit only while preserving declared readouts and unit/triangle equations, with parents and cost retained.
operations.gap: Admissible edits depend on the supplied support and observation policy.

operations.name: Uniform family admission
operations.rule: H_F is the intersection of member permission profiles for a common request family.
operations.gap: Not a summary of arbitrary history observations or metric cost.

operations.name: Independent carrier copying/pairing
operations.rule: Introduce explicitly supplied operand occurrences with their dependency data.
operations.gap: Fresh labels and repeated composition do not establish independent copying.

relations.statement: Encode and decode are inverse; canonical comparisons compose by inverse-codec cancellation.
Actual/reference composites and residual agree across bracketings; retained construction trees remain distinct.
Profile intersection is associative and covariant under passive relabelling under the declared common-request policy.

retired_gaps.reason: The PP/SP/PS experiment is not the governing native grammar. Identifying it with every operation is not a completion requirement; any claimed adapter remains separately accountable.

The authoritative native grammar already has type-theoretic equality and retained witnesses. A finite presentation of all equalities or a total equality decision algorithm is not required for its generating grammar.

gaps.acceptance: Record the source sorts, structure maps, equations, permitted constructions and equivalence criterion, with authoritative source references. Then audit dependencies against that fixed signature.

Identify authoritative admission boundaries for mathematical Marici operations and map every admitted family to grammar rules, or retain explicit unsupported families. The nine-row contract census is only a local slice.

Supply generation-preserving typed interpretations of the remaining retained-path and policy computations into the declared native closure, with actual admission data or an explicit obstruction. The split/reassemble P-kind sketch is constructive only modulo the step_decoder/step_lift presentation.

existing_interpretations.claim: A Filler a b (equivalence + pointed witness) is interpreted as a compare-rule application in the native Resolve grammar. Given Resolve S a and Resolve S b, apply(compare-rule a b e p)(da, db) produces the composed comparison.
A FramePackage (Complete package + Filler a a) is interpreted as a compare-rule application via Application.perform. This maps the frame.passive contract operation to the native grammar.
reference.substitute contract operation: compose-rule with identity comparison. Given a comparison C: a→b and derivations, produces Resolve S (compose-comparisons a b b e (idEquiv) p refl).

record.reindex contract operation: Pi-congruence-rule applied pointwise to an I-indexed family. Given pointwise equivalences e_i, witnesses p_i, and derivations for old and new families, produces Resolve S (Pi-comparison).
family.admit contract operation: same Pi-congruence pattern as reindex, with the reference family as uniform standard.
